svg.title: K13: the lockdown NetworkPolicy blocks DNS
svg.desc: The NetworkPolicy lockdown selects the app Pods and allows egress only to Redis on port 6379. The app first needs to look up the name redis via CoreDNS in kube-system on port 53. That lookup is dropped, so the app cannot find Redis. The fix adds an egress rule for DNS.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Locked down, and now nothing can find anything

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A NetworkPolicy that lists only Redis also blocks the DNS lookup that finds Redis

svg.text: Once a policy selects Pods for Egress, everything it does not list is blocked, including DNS.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Redis is up and the rule to it is there, yet the app logs: cannot reach redis at redis:6379: Try again.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep lockdown and add one egress rule: DNS (port 53) to the kube-system namespace.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Needs a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicy (kind, Calico, Cilium, GKE and most playgrounds). break.sh checks this first.
